app.title: Android Utility
apps.system_tooltip: System application. Uninstalling or disabling it may brick the device.
apps.disable_system_tooltip: Android may block disabling system applications from ADB.

apps.load_name_tooltip: Reads this application's APK to resolve its name. Slower than the package name but affects one app only.

error.label_cache: Could not save the application-name cache: {error}
